value.name: serves boy's drink
value.description: Asha places a cup beside the boy's plate and adjusts a napkin while quietly checking on his preferences.
evidence: She put the cup beside the boy's plate and tucked a paper napkin under the edge of it, asking him without looking up whether his brother liked the crust on or off, and he answered off without lifting his head from the toast.

value.name: receives Rosa's first message
value.description: Asha notices her phone pulse and reads Rosa's first instruction to go with papers in hand.
evidence: The phone by the sugar bowl pulsed once against the laminate, a short single beat this time, and when she turned it a quarter inch the line from Rosa read paper in hand, go;

value.name: delays after reading message
value.description: Asha lets the phone go dark and pauses instead of acting immediately.
evidence: she let the screen darken and did not move yet

value.name: reads Claire's hesitation
value.description: Asha notices Claire's subtle hand movement and understands Claire is waiting for direction without asking.
evidence: Claire's hand on the counter shifted slightly, the fingers spreading and then settling, and Asha understood that Claire had read the angle of her shoulder and was waiting to be told what came next without having to ask.

value.name: buys time with cup
value.description: Asha nudges the cup closer to the boy's plate as a way of delaying the inevitable.
evidence: She slid the cup a half inch closer to the boy's plate, the way a person buys another minute, and kept her gaze on the rim.

value.name: receives Rosa's evacuation order
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's second message telling her to clear everyone out and leave immediately.
evidence: The phone gave one more short beat against the laminate, and when Asha turned it she read Rosa's last line: clear them out, leave now.

value.name: starts clearing the table
value.description: Asha sets the phone down and begins removing the boy's plate from the table.
evidence: She set the phone face down and reached for the boy's plate, sliding it out from under the heel of toast he had not finished

value.name: asks about shoes
value.description: Asha quietly asks the boy whether his shoes are by the door, signaling an imminent departure.
evidence: and asked him in the same low voice whether he had his shoes by the door

value.name: withholds answer from Claire
value.description: Asha recognizes Claire is about to ask something she cannot answer and decides not to respond.
evidence: Claire's hand lifted finally from the counter, more reflex than decision, and Asha registered the motion without turning toward it; what Claire was about to ask was something Asha could not answer from this room, and the not-answering would have to stand.

value.name: cleans knife and prepares to leave
value.description: Asha wipes the jam knife, drops it in the sink, and crouches for a bag, preparing to go.
evidence: She wiped the jam knife on the napkin, dropped it into the sink, and crouched for the bag at her
